name: Inovti Solucoes em Informatica Ltda
notes:
AS264559 operates from three datacentre sites in the Sao Paulo region, Brazil.

We originate only our own direct allocations from LACNIC/NIC.br: 138.0.216.0/22 and 2804:2184::/32. We provide transit to no other autonomous system.

Routing security: RPKI ROAs are published covering 100% of the prefixes we originate, in both IPv4 and IPv6, with maxLength set to the longest prefix we actually announce. route and route6 objects are maintained in IRR, and our AS-SET is AS264559:AS-ALL.

Peering policy is open. Requests to noc@inovti.com.br.
